description:
Synopsis

Class Code: 16

NAICS Code: 336413

Subject: PLATE ASSEMBLY,DRIV

Solicitation Number: SPRRA1-26-Q-0023

Set Aside Code: N/A

Description:

No telephone requests will be accepted. Direct your requests and communication to: ATTN: DLA-AHA, Samary RodriguezHernandez, Contract Specialist, via e-mail: samary.rodriguez-hernandez@dla.mil. For request for solicitation, provide your name, the company name and Cage Code and a telephone number.

PRON: AX6C0464AX. The Government proposes to acquire on a Firm Fixed Price contract a quantity of 231 each of a PLATE ASSEMBLY,DRIV; NSN: 1615-01-567-7013; Part Number: 114DS344-1 applicable to the CH-47.

Production Lead Time (PLT) with First Article Testing is 231 each, 1260 Days After Contract Award (DACA). PLT without First Article Testing is 231 each, 840 DACA with deliveries to TINKER AFB, OK, 73145-8000.

This item is restricted to the following:

BOEING DISTRIBUTION SERVICES, INC., CAGE CODE: 2V484 THE BOEING COMPANY, CAGE CODE: 77272 REXNORD INDUSTRIES, LLC., CAGE CODE: 46HD1

The rights to use the data needed to purchase this part from additional source(s) are not owned by the Government and cannot be purchased, developed, or otherwise obtained. It is uneconomical to reverse engineer this part.

All offerors must meet prequalification requirements in order to be eligible for award. Firms that recognize and can produce the required item described above are encouraged to identify themselves. Firms are encouraged to seek source approval in order to compete for future solicitations by visiting AvMC's public website: https://www.avmc.army.mil/Directorates/SRD/TechDataMgmt

All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered by the Agency. The closing date annotated is an estimated date and may be adjusted dependent upon the date of release for solicitation; however, the solicitation will not close prior to the date stated above. Foreign Firms are reminded that all requests for solicitation must be processed through their respective embassies.
